verdict.rationale: Mistral is an API-first service. Its official Python/TypeScript SDKs (installable via pip), REST API requests and asynchronous batch inference let it be driven non-interactively from scripts, which supports headless automation. Nothing in the evidence documents CI-specific usage: no CI guide, no headless CLI, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. missing for 10: CI/CD integration docs or examples, an official CLI for pipeline use, a published OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: We provide official SDK clients in both Python and Typescript
Batching allows you to run asynchronous inference on large inputs in parallel
